method.description: Native field-list order; nonnegative weights only; union of strict vertical cylinders centered at field center minus5Y plus zone offset; highest weight wins, equal weight retains first index. Not nearest-tower.

geezah_identity.limit: Geezah label tied through the frozen named tower; no independent localization-table extraction.

limitations: Membership proves region containment of captured orb positions only, not safe traversal or absence of local environmental volumes.
No mandatory traversal requirements or early availability should be encoded from membership alone.
Frozen capture positions and GUIDs retained exactly; no IDs allocated or nearest-tower proxy used.
No selected position belongs to a later cold-region field under native weighting. Routes to positions remain unverified.
